news.title: This is the man tasked with waking football’s ‘sleeping giant’. It won’t be easy
news.lede: In his first public interview after joining Manchester United, Mauricio Pochettino gave a glimpse of how he’s going to go about the enormous task of awakening the sleeping giant the Red Devils have become. “It’s about to start to act and to change things, and to try and affect in a good way all the areas, to try to really believe that we can recover that feeling about to win,“he said. Mauricio Pochettino was coach of the USA at the FIFA World Cup earlier this year. The enormity of the task which lays ahead of Pochettino at Old Trafford is one the Argentinian is aware of, but insists he has the capabilities to turn the current situation around.

news.title: Black Challenge enter first Amputee World Cup semi with bonuses, per diems unpaid
news.lede: Ghana's amputee team reached the World Cup semi-finals without match bonuses; a Gold Fields-backed deal now promises US$8,000 a player if they reach the final. Ghana's Black Challenge go into their first Amputee Football World Cup semi-final against holders Türkiye with match bonuses and per diems still unpaid, the team says. The fixture kicks off at the San Martín Stadium in San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico, at 7:30pm local time on Friday, which is 1:30am on Saturday, Ghana time. Stephen Richard Obeng's side lost 2-0 to Angola and drew 1-1 with Colombia before beating Iraq 6-0, the United States 3-1 and Egypt 2-0.

news.title: 2026 Amputee World Cup: Gold Fields backs payment of Black Challenge bonuses, players to receive $8,000 each
news.lede: Gold Fields Ghana Limited has agreed to support the full payment of bonuses owed to Ghana's national amputee football team, the Black Challenge, following discussions involving the Ghana Football Association (GFA) and the National Paralympic Committee of Ghana (NPC Ghana). The agreement will see the team's 2027 sponsorship allocation brought forward to settle approved per diem and match bonuses covering the group stage through to the final of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico. According to a statement released by NPC Ghana on Friday, November 20, each player and member of the delegation is expected to receive $8,000 should Ghana reach the final of the competition.

news.title: Ghana amputee national team facing Türkiye Friday night at Football World Cup in Mexico
news.lede: Ghana’s Black Challenge are chasing a place in the final of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico when they face defending champions Türkiye on Friday night [Nov 20]. Five matches into the tournament, the players are yet to receive their allowances from the Ministry of Sports and Recreation, according to National Paralympic Committee (NPC) Ghana President Samson Deen. This is despite the Ghana Football Association (GFA) activating a US$500,000 sponsorship allocation from Gold Fields Ghana for amputee football. Deen said the national team had not received its financial entitlements despite its performances at the tournament.
